entities.summary: Ugolino di Nerio was a prominent Italian painter active in Siena and Florence between 1317 and 1327. He is best known for his frescoes in the Siena Cathedral, which showcased his mastery of the Sienese school of painting. Ugolino di Nerio was a key figure in the development of the city of Siena, and his work had a lasting impact on the city's artistic heritage. His frescoes continue to be celebrated for their beauty and historical significance, and he remains a beloved figure in the world of art history. The exact date of his birth is unknown, but his death in 1330 marked the end of an era in Sienese art. Ugolino di Nerio's legacy extends beyond his own work, as he played a role in shaping the artistic identity of the city and contributing to the cultural heritage of Italy.
